item.title: Gave notebook data for Jupyter instead of formatted data
item.body:
Type: Bug Asked GitHub Copilot the following in an already existing jupyter notebook: Do some hyper-parameter tuning on the model to try find the best mode Got this response: { "cells": [ { "cell_type": "markdown", "metadata": { "id": "0e92e803", "language": "markdown" }, "source": [ "# XGBoost Regression for Latitude and Longitude Prediction", "This notebook demonstrates how to use XGBoost to predict 'longitude' and 'latitude' from 'hour' and 'speed' columns in Master5G.csv." ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "973db15c", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Import required libraries", "import pandas as pd", "from xgboost import XGBRegressor", "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV", "from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error", "import joblib", "import numpy as np", "import torch" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "0507a7b1", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Load the dataset", "df = pd.read_csv('Master5G.csv')", "df.head()" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "0f57a35e", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Prepare features and targets", "X = df[['hour', 'speed']]", "y_long = df['longitude']", "y_lat = df['latitude']" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "4b4d425d", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Split data into train and test sets", "X_train, X_test, y_long_train, y_long_test = train_test_split(X, y_long, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)", ", , y_lat_train, y_lat_test = train_test_split(X, y_lat, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "metadata": { "language": "markdown" }, "source": [ "## Hyper-parameter Tuning with GridSearchCV", "We will use GridSearchCV to find the best hyper-parameters for the XGBoost regressors." ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Define parameter grid for XGBoost", "param_grid = {", " 'n_estimators': [50, 100, 200],", " 'max_depth': [3, 5, 7],", " 'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.1, 0.2],", " 'subsample': [0.8, 1.0],", " 'colsample_bytree': [0.8, 1.0]", "}" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Grid search for longitude model", "xgb_long = XGBRegressor(random_state=42)", "grid_search_long = GridSearchCV(xgb_long, param_grid, cv=3, scoring='neg_mean_squared_error', verbose=1, n_jobs=-1)", "grid_search_long.fit(X_train, y_long_train)", "print('Best params for longitude:', grid_search_long.best_params)", "print('Best score for longitude:', -grid_search_long.best_score)" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Grid search for latitude model", "xgb_lat = XGBRegressor(random_state=42)", "grid_search_lat = GridSearchCV(xgb_lat, param_grid, cv=3, scoring='neg_mean_squared_error', verbose=1, n_jobs=-1)", "grid_search_lat.fit(X_train, y_lat_train)", "print('Best params for latitude:', grid_search_lat.best_params_)", "print('Best score for latitude:', -grid_search_lat.best_score_)" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Train best models with best parameters", "best_xgb_long = grid_search_long.best_estimator_", "best_xgb_lat = grid_search_lat.best_estimator_", "best_xgb_long.fit(X_train, y_long_train)", "best_xgb_lat.fit(X_train, y_lat_train)" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "474b11c2", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Predict and evaluate", "y_long_pred = best_xgb_long.predict(X_test)", "y_lat_pred = best_xgb_lat.predict(X_test)", "mse_long = mean_squared_error(y_long_test, y_long_pred)", "mse_lat = mean_squared_error(y_lat_test, y_lat_pred)", "print(f'Longitude MSE: {mse_long}')", "print(f'Latitude MSE: {mse_lat}')" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "467a2963", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Save the trained models as .pt files", "best_xgb_long.save_model('xgb_longitude_model.pt')", "best_xgb_lat.save_model('xgb_latitude_model.pt')", "print('Models saved as xgb_longitude_model.pt and xgb_latitude_model.pt')" ] }, { "cell_type": "code", "metadata": { "id": "e7cf5a2f", "language": "python" }, "source": [ "# Save (value, prediction) pairs for longitude and latitude to CSV", "results_df = pd.DataFrame({", " 'longitude_true': np.array(y_long_test),", " 'longitude_pred': y_long_pred,", " 'latitude_true': np.array(y_lat_test),", " 'latitude_pred': y_lat_pred", "})", "results_df.to_csv('latlon_predictions_vs_true.csv', index=False)", "results_df.head()" ] } ] } Extension version: 0.26.7 VS Code version: Code 1.99.3 (17baf841131aa23349f217ca7c570c76ee87b957,
